_note: Your own SDXL / Illustrious / NoobAI checkpoint, e.g. one downloaded from Civitai. Put it at models/checkpoints/my-checkpoint.safetensors and use its file name (with or without .safetensors) as the model. Nothing else to configure: on RunPod the file is uploaded for you, or sent once to your storage if JENA_STORAGE is set in .env.
